items.explanation: The nosotros form of ser is somos.
optionNotes: Son is for ellos, ellas and ustedes.
Es is for él, ella and usted.

items.explanation: A job after ser has no article: Es médico.
optionNotes: No un before a job on its own.
Mi hermano is one person: es.

items.prompt: How do you say “I'm 30 years old”?
items.explanation: Age takes tener in Spanish: Tengo 30 años.
optionNotes: Ser is not used for age.
Estar is not used for age.
Ser de is for origin, not age.

items.explanation: The tú form of ser is eres.
optionNotes: Es is for él, ella and usted.
